criteria.description: Validate exact static GLB, source reopen, two distinct queued rebuilds, actual vertex counts and budgets, dependencies and scale.

Personally inspect eight exact final512px views; preserve subject identity and full-volume form. Concept hero/top/reverse personally inspected. Keep distinct grains and3 exposed nuclei but reject overly regular onion rings. Integrate uneven discontinuous bands on cut surfaces only, with off-center nuclei; do not wrap stripes around uncut exteriors. Shallow base remains subordinate.

Sixteen discrete irregular rounded coated grains rest in a shallow quiet sediment patch; three front grains have deliberate flat teaching cuts. Cut grains show uneven roughly concentric partly interrupted coatings around off-center nuclei; exterior uncut grains are irregular rough rounded bodies, not striped balls. Grains remain separate recognizable volumes, not a continuous stromatolite or thrombolitic mass; continuous closed cutfaces and undersides. Generic pedagogical loose oncoid bed, not reconstruction of a measured Hydra bed or a single source locality. UGS primary slab/core pixels support cm-scale shapes and coating/nucleus relationships; Hydra text supports irregular overlapping lamination but its1.8–4.1mm grain dimensions are not imported. Art arrangement,count,color,size and enlarged legibility are explicit; no assertion of a specific organism or unique growth process.
